title: Browser agent that picks each action with Jev
text:
Breaking: Browser Use + Jev = Ultrafast ⚡

Findings flights took 7s and cost only $0.0039 🤯

> new action space every step
> DOM state space
> small LLM fallback to type

(this video is at 1x speed btw)

Built a tiny open source browser agent. try it below ↓
summary: An open source browser agent that asks Jev to choose the next action from the page state, with a small LLM used only for typing. Speed and cost figures are the author's.

media.alt: Screen recording of a browser agent searching for flights
